A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
intention to participate in firm-hosted online travel communities depends on the intention to use the host firm’s services/products and on the intention to recommend it.
online travel communities are a new phenomenon that has a positive effect on the firm that hosts it.
online travel communities are a powerful tool that can be used by firms in order to create and strengthen their relationship with consumers, and, therefore, increase their profitability.
The main takeaway from our work is that
online travel communities can be an important source for firms in order to increase their sales and to improve their image.
